html:
Discovering the beauty of Ti Top peak, visitors will catch an island from the high hill, from here they can see the whole beauty of the sea and islands, the vastness and majesty of Ha Long Bay opening right before their eyes.

Ha Long Bay has long been a famous tourist attraction that attracts visitors to visit and enjoy, especially in the summer when visitors from all over the world come here to visit and enjoy the scenery and participate in many interesting games on the sea.

When talking about Ha Long, visitors cannot help but mention beautiful stops such as: Dragon Eye Island, Tuan Chau Island, Hon Gai, Sung Sot Cave… in which Ti Top Island stands out with its own unique beauty.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Ha Long, visitors should visit Ti Top Island to admire the beauty that nature has bestowed upon this place, the island has a crescent-shaped sandy beach, the four seasons of high tides have washed it clean and white, visitors when coming to the island can walk barefoot on the sand.

Ti Top Island has left many memories, and Uncle Ho named the island Ti Top Island, so the island is a place that leaves many memories. If you set foot here, you will encounter an island with a steep bank. You should conquer Ti Top peak to admire the beauty of Ha Long Bay from above, a poetic landscape.

On the way to the top of the mountain, visitors will conquer a spacious stone embankment. Visitors will look down below to see the vegetation and ecosystem of Ha Long Bay. Currently, Titop Island is very suitable for visitors who like to participate in thrilling games such as parasailing, banana boating, etc.

On the top of the mountain is a beautiful stop, from here visitors can fully admire the beauty of Ha Long Bay from above. On the top of the mountain, there is a watchtower.

From the observation tower, visitors can admire the scenic Bai Tho Mountain and Bai Chay Bridge across Cua Luc Bay, the Queen Cable Car and the Sun Wheel like a giant wheel high in the sky or the towering Bo Hon Island, in the distance is the mountain range of Hon Soi Sim, Hon Dam Nam, Hon Dai Thanh…

So let’s join Vietlook Travel to Ha Long today to conquer the beauty of Ti Top Mountain, stop at the observation tower to admire the beauty of Ha Long from above, with clear blue sea water and boats connecting to the open sea, a truly beautiful scene, will bring visitors the most perfect vacation on the island.
